title: The Mirror Principle
hook: Your product feels disjointed because your team is.
statement: Whatever you build ends up shaped like your org chart.
explainer: Every handoff between teams turns into a seam in the product. A split-up team ships a split-up product. If you want a clean product, design the team first.
sop: List your product's main parts and who owns each one.
Count the Teams involved in building it.
Spot seams that exist only because of a handoff.
Redraw team lines to match the product you want.
equation_example: 6 Teams building one product. 6 × (6 - 1) ÷ 2 = 15 handoff points. Add teams and that number climbs fast, and the product starts cracking along those lines. Fewer, well-defined teams means a cleaner product.
question: Find one awkward spot in your product and name the two teams it sits between.
closing_statement: What you build carries the shape of how you're organized.
